findings.title: codeMaps.faultCause cas-link → CAS.LINK_FAILED is outside closed error vocabulary
findings.detail: faultCauseToErrorCode maps cas-link to CAS.LINK_FAILED, but codeVocabulary.errorCodes does not contain CAS.LINK_FAILED. No golden exercises it, so D5 never fires. The map is not a closed total function into the declared vocabulary — checker does not validate maps ⊆ vocab or injectivity. Author knownLimitations list the missing golden but not the vocab hole.
findings.requiredFix: Add CAS.LINK_FAILED to errorCodes (with remedy) OR remove cas-link from the map; add D11: every codeMaps value ∈ vocab and each map is injective; add golden or mark enum value reserved.

findings.title: A1-D9-V14-04 not fixed: completeness golden still uses relation-missing deficiency
findings.detail: deficiency enum and map include query-completeness-unmet → QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET with a distinct remedy. The golden that is exactly that scenario still uses required-relation-missing. D10 will happily validate the wrong code because axes and payload agree on the wrong model.
findings.requiredFix: Set deficiency=query-completeness-unmet and reasonCodes=[QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET] on query-required-completeness-missing.

findings.title: A1-D9-V14-02 not fixed: serve graceful stop still models user-interrupt interruption
findings.detail: Unchanged from v1.4. Dead axis that would flip class if derive order changes.
findings.requiredFix: interruption=none for serve clean/graceful; checker invariant for commandKind=serve.

findings.title: Owed goldens still absent; P-4 tier code never on the wire in fixtures
findings.detail: Unused reason codes: COVERAGE.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, COVERAGE.LANGUAGE_TIER_UNSUPPORTED, QUERY.COMPLETENESS_UNMET. LANGUAGE_TIER_UNSUPPORTED is the termination face of P-4 loud tier — a contract without a golden is aspirational.
findings.requiredFix: Add three goldens (tier unsupported, budget exhausted, completeness unmet) before seal.

findings.title: Deficiency axes are near-renames of codes — acceptable if scenario-faithful; still need blind re-authoring of the new fields
findings.detail: V14-01 is closed for underdetermination. Residual risk: author can set deficiency to whatever code they want and D10 passes (mutual consistency of a larger axis set). That is inherent to input-driven pure maps. Mitigations: (1) blind re-author deficiency/rejection/fault for a sample; (2) cross-axis invariants (e.g. baseline deficiency requires requiredCoverage=satisfied; identity-expired requires domainCondition=addressed-identity-unresolved).
findings.requiredFix: Add cross-axis invariant checks (D12) for load-bearing pairs; optional second-author sample of new axes.

findings.title: knownLimitations/peerReview still refer to re-run against v1.4
findings.detail: Stale meta after v1.5; confuses the next reviewer about which contract is live.
findings.requiredFix: Point peerReviewRequired at v1.5 blind re-run; drop v1.4-only wording.

Injective deficiency/rejection maps for exercised keys work.
